description: Extends g{1..5}_trigger_eval.json by recording the post-refactor gate-firing paths: which critic agent each adversarial gate dispatches, how many parallel votes are spawned (asymmetric), where in the workflow the dispatch fires, and which cross-cutting skills the gate's verdict cites for evidence. Post-refactor: G2/G4 cite verification-failures (replacing the old ivy-error-patterns); G3/G4/G5 each dispatch g-fidelity-critic x3 inline. This eval pairs with g{1..5}_trigger_eval.json (which only graded trigger-phrase matching) to give the full gate contract.

g3.dispatch_locus: scaffold-ops Phase 3 test-spec gate (per H ARD-GATE) — inline with G2

g4.dispatch_locus: verify-ops Phase 4 verification-gate — inline post ivy_verify

g5.dispatch_locus: review-ops Phase 4 trace-analysis-gate — inline post traceability extraction

g7.dispatch_locus: triage-ops Phase 2 — inline post-diagnose, pre-fix (vets root-cause claim before user-confirmation prompt)

g8.dispatch_locus: triage-ops Phase 3 Step 3 — inline post-fix, pre-return (vets post-fix indicators before reporting recovery)
